bio: Lars Aukema is a chef who does not need top-of-the-range ingredients to create exciting dishes. Having worked under the tutelage of Jonnie Boer for a long time, he has now proven himself to be a dab hand at showcasing flavours from the region and around the globe. He combines, for instance, yellowtail tartare with crunchy kohlrabi, topped with yellowtail sashimi and dusted with black cardamom and kaffir lime zest. Lime gel, marinated green strawberry and a fermented kohlrabi broth add the finishing touches to this understated dish. This is a subtle flavour combination you won't forget.
